live: {channel} is live now — come say hi!
adoptBanner: Twitch credentials are now set in the Twitch channel module. Take yours over here:
adoptButton: Take my credentials over to the Twitch channel
adoptDone: Your Twitch credentials were taken over by the Twitch channel, which is now used. You may empty the old fields (advanced settings).
adoptUnavailable: The Twitch channel module is not available: install and enable it to take your credentials over.
adoptNothing: Nothing to take over: the old fields are empty.
adoptOk: Taken over by the Twitch channel: {fields}.
adoptAlready: Nothing to take over: the Twitch channel already has its credentials.
needCredentials: Enter your Twitch credentials in the Twitch channel module to show the player only when you are live. Without them, the player is not shown.
